newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures remain lower after auction results.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures remain lower after auction results.

text.p: Aug 5 - U.S. debt futures remained lower after the results of the three-yr note auction. Average yield was 6.041 pct, in-line with estimates of 6.03 pct to 6.04 pct. Traders said volume was exceptionally light. Some look for the rally to resume following 10-yr note sale on Wednesday. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750))
